body:
SUPPORT-ASSESSMENT P0 RULING: full explicit-basis migration approved.

Authorize all 17 additional paths enumerated in the decision note on bd-01M19956MFSG7076QE4J66T7E9. Do not use the narrower trusted-default overload. LocalCostModel.cost and externalCost become fallible; one checked SupportBasis is supplied at GraphHsmm invocation, passed into every producer call, and used to validate/rebuild each CostBreakdown. All 21 direct infer sites move.

HsmmResult/hsmm-v4 carry the complete support basis. Embedded basis proves internal consistency only; authenticated invocation provenance requires an independently admitted expected basis/receipt. Do not claim arbitrary custom-model total provenance from support-basis consistency. Exact refusal, mismatch, non-finite/overflow, wire-tamper, and authority-status courts plus cross-platform/reference-scope gates are in the bead decision.

The active reservation may now expand to exactly those paths. Existing reviewers, v3 refusal, v4 exact-byte court, documentation dependency, and no-landing/no-close limits remain.
